stories.title: Minneapolis: Operation Metro Surge

the_operation: Dec 4 2025: DHS announced Operation Metro Surge
Jan 6 2026: Expansion - 'largest immigration enforcement operation ever'
3,000+ federal agents deployed (2,000 ICE + 1,000 Border Patrol)
ICE doubled force since early 2025 - now 22,000 agents
12,000 new officers hired in 4 months from 220,000 applicants
$170 billion for border/interior enforcement over 4 years

the_shootings.name: Renée Good
the_shootings.stated_by_police: not the target of a law enforcement investigation
the_shootings.aftermath: Gov. Walz proclaimed Jan 9 'Renee Good Day'

the_shootings.name: Alex Pretti
video_shows: Stood between agent and woman agent had pushed to ground
Wrestled to ground by several agents
the_shootings.stated_by_police: lawful gun owner, Minnesota permit, no criminal record

the_child.name: Liam Conejo Ramos
the_child.detail: Taken into custody with father after arriving home from preschool
the_child.legal: Judge Fred Biery: temporary stay on deportation
the_child.pattern: MPR: 'ICE detaining, moving Minnesota children to Texas faster than courts can respond'

the_statistics: Minneapolis police chief: 'Third shooting in less than three weeks by federal agents'
Mayor Frey & Chief O'Hara: 'Three homicides in Minneapolis in 2026 so far. Two carried out by federal immigration enforcement agents.'
2,450% increase in people with no criminal record held in ICE detention
the_response: Jan 23: General strike - tens of thousands marched in -10°F
After Jan 24 shooting: federal agents fired tear gas and stun grenades at protesters
the_surveillance: Palantir tool ELITE: populates map with deportation targets, provides 'confidence score' on addresses
ICE-CMS data sharing agreement: access to 80 million Medicaid patients' data
DHS uses Palantir to track air travel, driver's license scans, cell phone locations
facts.video_vs_official: NPR: 'Videos and eyewitnesses refute federal account of Minneapolis shooting'
facts.fbi_noncooperation: FBI refuses to cooperate with local law enforcement - blocking evidence that would allow criminal charges against Jonathan Ross
facts.international: Ecuador filed protest: ICE agent attempted to enter Ecuadorean consulate in Minneapolis

political_positions.mayor_frey: City will not enforce federal immigration laws
political_positions.vp_vance: Traveled to Minneapolis Jan 22, defended agents

personnel_changes: Bovino and some agents 'expected to leave soon'
Tom Homan now 'main point of contact'

chris_hedges.frame: Decaying empires turn to savage control previously used abroad at home
chris_hedges.comparison: Compared Minneapolis killings to how Iraqis in Fallujah and Afghans in Helmand province were 'terrorised by heavily armed American execution squads'
chris_hedges.call: Resistance means organizing to disrupt the machinery of commerce and government

whitney_webb.frame: Palantir created to privatize Bush-era Total Information Awareness program
whitney_webb.insight: Tools like Palantir have made traditional blackmail operations no longer necessary
whitney_webb.warning: Counter-elites may be worse than the globalists they oppose

patterns: Two of three shot were American citizens - not stated targets of immigration enforcement
The professions: VA nurse, woman 'blocking the street'
